title: Kombucha Cocktails
notes: Simple Syrup is simply 2 parts white sugar to 1 part water heated until all the sugar is dissolved and then left to cool. Make a batch and keep it on hand.

methodSections.heading: Kombucha-Politan
steps: A couple of twists on the classic Cosmo. Blackberry Kombucha is strikingly similar to cranberry juice in tartness making it the perfect replacement. In a mixing glass filled with ice, stir all the ingredients thoroughly, strain into a martini glass and garnish with lime.
